title: Relocate Marbles
statement:
`nums` gives occupied marble positions. For each step, move every marble at `moveFrom[i]` to `moveTo[i]`. Each source position is guaranteed to be occupied at that step. Return the distinct occupied positions in ascending order.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,6,7,8], moveFrom = [1,7,2], moveTo = [2,9,5]
Output: [5,6,8,9]
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,1,3,3], moveFrom = [1,3], moveTo = [2,2]
Output: [2]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length, moveFrom.length <= 10^5`
- `moveFrom.length == moveTo.length`
- All positions are in `[1, 10^9]`
- Every `moveFrom[i]` is occupied when its move occurs
